title.ru: Present Perfect вместо Past Simple (и наоборот)
title.en: Present Perfect instead of Past Simple

why.ru: С «since» и «already» действие связано с настоящим, поэтому Past Simple не подходит.
why.en: With “since” and “already” the action is linked to the present, so the Past Simple fails.

fix.ru: Проверьте, идёт ли действие до сих пор: если да — have/has + V3.
fix.en: Check whether the action continues up to now: if yes, use have/has + V3.

why.ru: «Look!», «now», «at the moment» указывают на момент речи.
why.en: “Look!”, “now” and “at the moment” point at the moment of speaking.

fix.ru: В момент речи: am/is/are + Ving.
fix.en: At the moment of speaking: am/is/are + Ving.

why.ru: Если одно действие произошло раньше другого, нужен Past Perfect.
why.en: When one action happened before another, the Past Perfect is required.

fix.ru: Раньше другого прошедшего — had + V3.
fix.en: Earlier than another past action: had + V3.

why.ru: Фоновое действие в прошлом описывается Past Continuous.
why.en: A background action in the past is described with the Past Continuous.

fix.ru: Фон — was/were + Ving, короткое действие — Past Simple.
fix.en: The background takes was/were + Ving; the short action takes the Past Simple.

why.ru: «Should have + V3» говорит о том, чего не сделали.
why.en: “Should have + V3” describes what was not done.

fix.ru: Не выполнено в прошлом: should have + V3 (не «should did»).
fix.en: For an unfulfilled past action: should have + V3.

why.ru: «Must» — уверенность, «cannot have» — «не может быть, чтобы».
why.en: “Must” states certainty; “cannot have” states impossibility.

fix.ru: Для прошлого: must have + V3 / cannot have + V3.
fix.en: For the past: must have + V3 / cannot have + V3.

why.ru: В пассиве время показывает «be», поэтому нужен «will be + V3».
why.en: In the passive the verb “be” carries the tense, so “will be + V3” is required.

fix.ru: Будущее действие над предметом: will be + V3.
fix.en: A future action on the object: will be + V3.

title.en: The object does not act by itself

why.ru: Если подлежащее испытывает действие, нужен пассив.
why.en: When the subject receives the action, the passive is required.

fix.ru: was/were + V3, исполнитель — с «by».
fix.en: was/were + V3, with the doer introduced by “by”.

why.ru: После «if» будущее не употребляется.
why.en: The future is not used after “if”.

fix.ru: Условие — Present Simple, главная часть — will + V.
fix.en: The if-clause takes the Present Simple, the main clause will + V.

why.ru: Раз действие не состоялось, нужен III тип условия.
why.en: Because the action did not happen, the third conditional is required.

fix.ru: if + had + V3, would have + V3.
fix.en: if + had + V3, would have + V3.

why.ru: При переводе в косвенную речь время сдвигается назад.
why.en: In reported speech the tense shifts one step back.

fix.ru: will → would, is → was, Present Perfect → Past Perfect.
fix.en: will → would, is → was, Present Perfect → Past Perfect.

why.ru: После предлога инфинитив невозможен.
why.en: The infinitive cannot follow a preposition.

fix.ru: interested in learning, without saying.
fix.en: interested in learning, without saying.

why.ru: Enjoy, avoid, mind, suggest требуют герундий, а не инфинитив.
why.en: Enjoy, avoid, mind and suggest take the gerund, not the infinitive.

fix.ru: Запомните группу: enjoy/avoid/mind/suggest + Ving.
fix.en: Memorise the group: enjoy/avoid/mind/suggest + Ving.

why.ru: «The» ставится перед единственным в своём роде и в устойчивых выражениях с инструментами.
why.en: “The” is used for unique objects and fixed expressions with instruments.

fix.ru: play the piano, the sun, the Netherlands.
fix.en: play the piano, the sun, the Netherlands.

why.ru: С неисчисляемыми, с приёмами пищи и в выражениях at school артикль не нужен.
why.en: Uncountable nouns, meals and expressions like at school take no article.

fix.ru: have breakfast, at school, advice, information.
fix.en: have breakfast, at school, advice, information.

why.ru: Выбор зависит от звука, а не от буквы.
why.en: The choice depends on the sound, not on the letter.

fix.ru: an hour, a university, an honest man.
fix.en: an hour, a university, an honest man.

why.ru: Advice, information, news не имеют формы множественного числа.
why.en: Advice, information and news have no plural form.

fix.ru: Some advice, a piece of news — через «piece».
fix.en: Use “some advice”, “a piece of news”.

title.en: The preposition belongs to its word

why.ru: Переводить предлог отдельно от слова нельзя.
why.en: The preposition cannot be translated apart from its word.

fix.ru: depend on, good at, interested in, responsible for.
fix.en: depend on, good at, interested in, responsible for.

why.ru: «Since» — точка отсчёта, «for» — отрезок времени.
why.en: “Since” takes a starting point, “for” takes a period.

fix.ru: since 2019 / for five years.
fix.en: since 2019 / for five years.

why.ru: Выбор зависит от исчисляемости и от количества предметов.
why.en: The choice depends on countability and on how many objects there are.

fix.ru: fewer students, less time, neither of two, none of many.
fix.en: fewer students, less time, neither of two, none of many.

why.ru: «It's» — сокращение «it is», притяжательное — «its».
why.en: “It's” means “it is”; the possessive form is “its”.

fix.ru: The company opened its office; it's raining.
fix.en: The company opened its office; it's raining.

why.ru: Прилагательное описывает предмет, наречие — действие.
why.en: An adjective describes a thing; an adverb describes an action.

fix.ru: The task is useful (прилагательное); he works usefully? — нет: works hard.
fix.en: The task is useful; the adverb is used with verbs.

why.ru: Hard — «усердно», hardly — «едва»: похожие слова, разный смысл.
why.en: Hard means “with effort”, hardly means “almost not”.

fix.ru: he works hard; he hardly works.
fix.en: he works hard; he hardly works.

why.ru: У коротких слов — -er/-est, у длинных — more/most; вместе их не смешивают.
why.en: Short words take -er/-est, long words take more/most; the two are not mixed.

fix.ru: better — the best, more interesting — the most interesting.
fix.en: better — the best, more interesting — the most interesting.

why.ru: После «his, my, the» и прилагательного стоит существительное.
why.en: After “his, my, the” and adjectives a noun stands.

fix.ru: achieve → achievement, kind → kindness.
fix.en: achieve → achievement, kind → kindness.

why.ru: Перед существительным и после «be» стоит прилагательное.
why.en: Before a noun and after “be” an adjective stands.

fix.ru: success → successful, ambition → ambitious.
fix.en: success → successful, ambition → ambitious.

why.ru: Глагол действия определяет наречие на -ly.
why.en: An action verb takes the adverb in -ly.

fix.ru: confident → confidently, angry → angrily.
fix.en: confident → confidently, angry → angrily.

why.ru: Отрицание образуется приставкой un-/im-/in-/dis-.
why.en: Negation is formed with un-/im-/in-/dis-.

fix.ru: possible → impossible, predictable → unpredictable.
fix.en: possible → impossible, predictable → unpredictable.

title.en: A fixed collocation in the gap

why.ru: В устойчивых выражениях ответ не выводится из правила.
why.en: In fixed expressions the answer does not follow from a rule.

fix.ru: be used to, keen on, fall asleep — учить целиком.
fix.en: be used to, keen on, fall asleep — learn them as a whole.

why.ru: Предлог зависит от соседнего слова, а не от русского перевода.
why.en: The preposition depends on its neighbouring word.

fix.ru: at nine o'clock, since childhood, for five years.
fix.en: at nine o'clock, since childhood, for five years.

why.ru: Русский глагол требует предлога, английский — нет: discuss, enter, marry.
why.en: Russian verbs may need a preposition where English ones do not: discuss, enter, marry.

fix.ru: Уберите предлог и перечитайте: discuss the plan, enter the room.
fix.en: Remove the preposition and reread: discuss the plan, enter the room.

why.ru: По-русски можно повторить подлежащее, по-английски — нет.
why.en: Russian may repeat the subject; English does not.

fix.ru: My friend lives in Brest (без «he»).
fix.en: My friend lives in Brest (without “he”).

why.ru: Дословный перевод сохраняет русскую форму вместо английской.
why.en: A word-for-word translation keeps Russian forms instead of English ones.

fix.ru: Смотрите на время и структуру: have never been to, if + Past Simple, would + V.
fix.en: Follow English patterns: have never been to, if + Past Simple, would + V.

title.ru: Разберите правило и попробуйте ещё раз
title.en: Review the rule and try again

why.ru: Ошибка не привязана к одной теме: посмотрите правило и разобранный пример.
why.en: The mistake is not tied to a single area: review the rule and the worked example.

fix.ru: Откройте «Правила», прочитайте карточку и выполните однотипные задания.
fix.en: Open “Rules”, read the card and do the analogous exercises.

why.ru: Обычное действие и расписание описываются Present Simple.
why.en: Habits and timetables take the Present Simple.

fix.ru: every day / on Mondays → V(s).
fix.en: every day / on Mondays → V(s).

title.en: An action in progress in the future

why.ru: «This time tomorrow» описывает действие в процессе, а не факт.
why.en: “This time tomorrow” describes an action in progress, not a fact.

fix.ru: will be + Ving.
fix.en: will be + Ving.

why.ru: «By the end of …» требует формы, которая подчёркивает завершение.
why.en: “By the end of …” needs a form that marks completion.

fix.ru: will have + V3.
fix.en: will have + V3.

why.ru: Подчёркивается сам процесс и его продолжительность.
why.en: The process and its duration are emphasised.

fix.ru: has/have been + Ving.
fix.en: has/have been + Ving.

why.ru: «Can» не имеет формы прошедшего времени; в прошлом — «could».
why.en: “Can” has no past form; the past of ability is “could”.

fix.ru: could swim when she was five.
fix.en: could swim when she was five.

why.ru: Совет выражают «should» и «had better»; «must» — обязанность.
why.en: Advice takes “should” or “had better”; “must” states obligation.

fix.ru: You should / had better take an umbrella.
fix.en: You should / had better take an umbrella.

why.ru: Запрет — «must not»; «may not» звучит как формальное разрешение.
why.en: A prohibition takes “must not”; “may not” sounds like a formal restriction.

fix.ru: Passengers must not smoke on board.
fix.en: Passengers must not smoke on board.

why.ru: Вежливая просьба начинается с «Could/Would you …?».
why.en: A polite request starts with “Could/Would you …?”.

fix.ru: Could you help me, please?
fix.en: Could you help me, please?

title.en: A general fact in the passive

why.ru: Действие совершается над подлежащим постоянно.
why.en: The action is regularly performed on the subject.

fix.ru: is/are + V3.
fix.en: is/are + V3.

why.ru: Важен результат к моменту речи, а не исполнитель.
why.en: The result up to now matters, not the doer.

fix.ru: has/have been + V3.
fix.en: has/have been + V3.

title.en: A passive action earlier than another

why.ru: Одно действие совершилось до другого прошедшего.
why.en: One action happened before another past action.

fix.ru: had been + V3.
fix.en: had been + V3.

why.ru: Действие происходило в определённый момент в прошлом.
why.en: The action was in progress at a past moment.

fix.ru: was/were being + V3.
fix.en: was/were being + V3.

why.ru: «If I were you» — нереальное условие: в главной части «would».
why.en: “If I were you” is unreal, so the main clause takes “would”.

fix.ru: if + Past Simple, would + V.
fix.en: if + Past Simple, would + V.

why.ru: После «I wish» время сдвигается назад: о прошлом — Past Perfect.
why.en: After “I wish” the tense shifts back: the past takes the Past Perfect.

fix.ru: I wish I had had more time.
fix.en: I wish I had had more time.

why.ru: Would like, want, decide, hope требуют инфинитив с «to».
why.en: Would like, want, decide and hope take the infinitive with “to”.

fix.ru: would like to read.
fix.en: would like to read.

title.en: A participle instead of a clause

why.ru: Причастие сокращает придаточное: письмо, которое отправили → the letter sent.
why.en: A participle shortens a clause: the letter that was sent → the letter sent.

fix.ru: Having heard the news, she called her mother.
fix.en: Having heard the news, she called her mother.

why.ru: С the употребляются названия стран во множественном числе, океаны, реки.
why.en: Plural country names, oceans and rivers take “the”.

fix.ru: the Netherlands, the USA, the Pacific.
fix.en: the Netherlands, the USA, the Pacific.

why.ru: В общем смысле множественное число идёт без артикля.
why.en: Plural nouns in a general sense take no article.

fix.ru: Cars are expensive.
fix.en: Cars are expensive.

why.ru: В пассиве исполнитель вводится предлогом «by», инструмент — «with».
why.en: In the passive the doer takes “by”, the instrument “with”.

fix.ru: written by Mark Twain / cut with a knife.
fix.en: written by Mark Twain / cut with a knife.

why.ru: Смысл глагола задаёт частица: fill in, look after, put off.
why.en: The particle decides the meaning: fill in, look after, put off.

fix.ru: Учите глагол вместе с частицей.
fix.en: Learn the verb with its particle.

why.ru: Точка — at, поверхность — on, пространство — in.
why.en: A point takes at, a surface on, a space in.

fix.ru: at the airport, on the wall, in the room.
fix.en: at the airport, on the wall, in the room.

why.ru: После глагола и предлога употребляется объектная форма (me, him, her).
why.en: After a verb or a preposition the object form is used (me, him, her).

fix.ru: It was me; they invited her.
fix.en: It was me; they invited her.

why.ru: Союзы употребляются парой: either … or, neither … nor, both … and.
why.en: These conjunctions come in pairs: either … or, neither … nor, both … and.

fix.ru: Neither the teacher nor the students were late.
fix.en: Neither the teacher nor the students were late.

why.ru: В порядковых дефис и -th/-st/-nd: twenty-first, fifth, third.
why.en: Ordinals use a hyphen and -th/-st/-nd: twenty-first, fifth, third.

fix.ru: on the twenty-first of May.
fix.en: on the twenty-first of May.

why.ru: Формы на -self согласуются с подлежащим: himself, herself, themselves.
why.en: The -self forms agree with the subject: himself, herself, themselves.

fix.ru: He did it himself.
fix.en: He did it himself.

why.ru: Предмет «разочаровывает» (disappointing), человек «разочарован» (disappointed).
why.en: Things are disappointing; people feel disappointed.

fix.ru: -ing о предмете, -ed о человеке.
fix.en: Use -ing for the cause, -ed for the person.

why.ru: Much/little — с неисчисляемыми, many/few — с исчисляемыми.
why.en: Much/little take uncountables; many/few take countables.

fix.ru: too much sugar, too many sweets.
fix.en: too much sugar, too many sweets.

why.ru: People, children, feet — множественное число не по общему правилу.
why.en: People, children, feet are irregular plurals.

fix.ru: Учите такие слова отдельно.
fix.en: Learn irregular plurals separately.

why.ru: Названия наук и неисчисляемые существительные требуют единственного числа.
why.en: Names of sciences and uncountable nouns take a singular verb.

fix.ru: Physics is difficult; the news is good.
fix.en: Physics is difficult; the news is good.

why.ru: Результаты «разочаровывают» (disappointing), а не «разочарованы».
why.en: Results are disappointing; people are disappointed.

fix.ru: The results were disappointing.
fix.en: The results were disappointing.

why.ru: Профессия образуется суффиксами -er/-or/-ist: translator, writer.
why.en: Professions take -er/-or/-ist: translator, writer.

fix.ru: translate → translator.
fix.en: translate → translator.

title.en: An auxiliary verb in the gap

why.ru: Пропуск может требовать have/had/will, а не смысловой глагол.
why.en: The gap may need have/had/will rather than a main verb.

fix.ru: had to wait, have been waiting.
fix.en: had to wait, have been waiting.

why.ru: «The more …, the better …» — устойчивая конструкция.
why.en: “The more …, the better …” is a fixed pattern.

fix.ru: the more you practise, the better you speak.
fix.en: the more you practise, the better you speak.

title.en: A modal verb in the gap

why.ru: Смысл подсказывает значение: способность, необходимость, запрет.
why.en: The meaning decides: ability, necessity or prohibition.

fix.ru: could not continue, had better tidy.
fix.en: could not continue, had better tidy.

title.en: A tense form in the gap

why.ru: «It was the first time that …» требует Past Perfect.
why.en: “It was the first time that …” takes the Past Perfect.

fix.ru: It was the first time that I had seen.
fix.en: It was the first time that I had seen.

why.ru: Союз может разрывать предложение, оставляя его без главной части.
why.en: A conjunction may split the sentence and leave it without its main part.

fix.ru: Уберите союз и проверьте структуру.
fix.en: Remove the conjunction and check the structure.

why.ru: Английский глагол сам управляет дополнением: need, enter, discuss.
why.en: English verbs govern their object directly: need, enter, discuss.

fix.ru: they need a helping hand.
fix.en: they need a helping hand.

why.ru: «Most easiest» и «less fewer» — две формы одного значения.
why.en: “Most easiest” and “less fewer” use two comparative markers for one meaning.

fix.ru: the easiest, fewer accidents.
fix.en: the easiest, fewer accidents.

why.ru: В косвенной речи will заменяется на would, а не соседствует с ним.
why.en: Reported speech replaces “will” with “would” instead of keeping both.

fix.ru: she would come later.
fix.en: she would come later.

why.ru: «How do you do?» — приветствие при знакомстве, а не вопрос о здоровье.
why.en: “How do you do?” greets a new acquaintance; it is not about health.

fix.ru: Ответ на него — то же приветствие.
fix.en: The answer repeats the same greeting.

why.ru: Объявление читается буквально: last admission, until, closes.
why.en: A notice is read literally: last admission, until, closes.

fix.ru: Сверьте время и слово-ограничитель.
fix.en: Check the time and the limiting word.

why.ru: У каждой ситуации своя формула: благодарность, извинение, предложение.
why.en: Each situation has its own formula: thanks, apology, offer.

fix.ru: Thank you → You are welcome; Sorry → That is all right.
fix.en: Thank you → You are welcome; Sorry → That is all right.

checklist.ru: Проверьте, не изменился ли смысл: время, число, порядок слов.
checklist.en: Check whether the meaning changed: tense, number, word order.

checklist.ru: Посмотрите на слово перед пропуском — оно подсказывает форму.
checklist.en: Look at the word before the gap — it suggests the form.
Reread the whole sentence after answering.

checklist.ru: Отдельно проверьте предлог и артикль: их чаще всего теряют.
checklist.en: Check the preposition and the article separately: they are the most frequent omissions.

checklist.ru: Если ответ не сходится, откройте правило из разбора ошибки.
checklist.en: If the answer does not work out, open the rule from the mistake analysis.
